observations: Torah 94 is a brief reported fragment — Reb Nosson explicitly states he did not merit to receive the full Torah ('וְהָיָה לוֹ בָּזֶה תּוֹרָה שְׁלֵמָה, וְלֹא זָכִיתִי לְקַבְּלָהּ'). The transmitted portion consists of a single conceptual move: the identification of three parallel bechinot of 'ראש' that converge when a person travels to the Tzaddik on Rosh Hashanah. All five dataset nodes (הצדיק, ראש, ראש בני ישראל, ראש השנה, מחו ודעתו) belong to one unified connected component built around the shared quality of 'ראשיות' (headship/primacy). There is no second domain, no opposing evil force named, and no independent sub-cluster of 3+ nodes forming a separate thematic family. The addition of 'שלשה ראשים' as a suggested new node (see additions file) would also belong to Package 1, not to a new package. Therefore, no new packages are warranted. The single Package 1 ('ראש — הצדיק, ראש השנה, והמח') fully covers all conceptual content of this Torah fragment.
